diffs.diff: chip ID register 0x1: part 134, datasheet reading 135
diffs.evidence: Adafruit's Gamepad QT pinout guide says the board uses 'the ATtiny816 running the' seesaw firmware, and Adafruit's seesaw library defines '#define SEESAW_HW_ID_CODE_TINY816 0x86' (0x86 = 134), whereas 135 (0x87) is the ATtiny817 code, so the second reading (which itself names ATtiny816) picked the wrong row.
